name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Algae, Basalt, and Lichen go with Dasari, Okafor, and Earth, in some order.
Europa goes with at least one of Bauer, Fontaine, or Basalt.
Between Callisto and Ganymede, one goes with Bauer and the other with Fontaine.
Callisto goes with exactly one of Dasari, Fontaine, or Rios.
Either Algae goes with Europa or Diatoms goes with Callisto.
Exactly one of these is true: Bauer goes with Titan; Okafor goes with Algae; Rios goes with Basalt.

hints.text: Suppose Dasari went with Callisto — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Dasari goes with Callisto.
Callisto goes with Dasari, so Bauer can't go with Callisto.
Callisto goes with Dasari, so Fontaine can't go with Callisto.
…but now the clue “Between Callisto and Ganymede, one goes with Bauer and the other with Fontaine” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Dasari does not go with Callisto.
